# Taylor & Francis

> A comprehensive academic publishing platform offering curated ebook collections, reference works, and digital resources across humanities, social sciences, and global development topics.

Taylor & Francis provides scholarly access to primary and secondary sources spanning historical periods, literary movements, and contemporary global issues. The platform includes specialized collections on British history, Romanticism, sustainable development, and other academic subjects through both original works and curated libraries.

## Core Collections & Reference Works

- [Home](https://www.taylorfrancis.com): Taylor & Francis homepage showcasing ebook collections and reference works across specialist subjects.
- [19th Century British Society](https://www.taylorfrancis.com/british-society): 19th Century British Society reference work (1789-1914) with primary sources and notable figures from England, Scotland, Wales, and Ireland.
- [Romanticism](https://www.taylorfrancis.com/romanticism): Romanticism ebook collection covering British and Irish Romanticism (1760-1830) with primary and secondary sources.
- [Sustainable Development Goals Online](https://taylorfrancis.com/sdgo): Sustainable Development Goals Online curated library supporting UN's call to action on poverty and inequality.
